facts.fact: Gabonreview reports ANPI-Gabon has digitalised the company-creation process on the Guichet Numérique de l'Investissement, launched three years earlier, and added a bank module on 1 June 2023.

ANPI-Gabon's annual report says all company creation and fee-payment procedures are dematerialised on the Guichet Numérique de l'Investissement, with 7,146 files submitted and paid from June 2020 to May 2021.

note: Only OECD Global Forum ratings on beneficial ownership information are stated, with no register in service named.
The FUP is a register of companies in the state's portfolio, not a register of firms or their registration.
The FUP registers the state's shareholdings, not firms; no business register stated.
The document concerns a social-benefit beneficiary file (GEF/CNAMGS), a programme's own list, not this register.
